<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

The launcher's commands and their default keys. Every command is also in the command palette (`ctrl+o`). To change a key, add the command's name under `[keymap]` in `config.toml`; `simstim config keymap` prints the keys in effect.

```toml
[keymap]
"session: delete" = "x"          # one key
"session: rename" = ["r", "f2"]  # several
"host: details" = ""             # palette only
```

| Command | Keys |
| --- | --- |
| session: new | `n` |
| session: new with the form | palette only |
| session: attach | `enter` |
| session: preview | `space` |
| session: rename | `r`, `f2` |
| session: delete | `d` |
| session: resume | `u` |
| session: copy attach command | `y` |
| session: next waiting | `w` |
| host: open | `enter` |
| host: add | `a` |
| host: set up | `s` |
| host: details | `i` |
| host: test | palette only |
| host: reconnect | palette only |
| host: remove | palette only |
| view: hosts | palette only |
| view: all sessions | palette only |
| view: search | `/` |
| view: toggle ended | `alt+e` |
| view: shortcuts | `?` |
| view: commands | `ctrl+o` |
| simstim: settings | palette only |
| simstim: about | palette only |
| simstim: quit | `q` |

While you are attached to a session, only two keys are the client's: `ctrl+\` detaches, and `ctrl+v` pastes an image from the clipboard. Both are settings in [the configuration](config.md); everything else goes to the agent unchanged.
